title: Wildsee Seefeld Strandbad
highlights: Natural moorland bathing lake located right on the southern edge of Seefeld
Two established heritage lidos: Strandbad Sonja and Strandbad Strandperle
Protected high moorland on the south shore with rare flora and playful squirrel woods
Flat circular walking trail equipped with numerous relaxing panoramic benches
kurzbeschreibung: The Wildsee in Seefeld offers refreshing swimming pleasures, protected moorland landscapes, and an enchanting Eichhörnchenwald.
beschreibung:
Swimming Lake and Natural Paradise in Seefeld

The approximately six-hectare Wildsee is picturesquely situated at 1,180 metres above sea level on the southern edge of Seefeld. Formed during the Würm ice age, this idyllic moorland lake is today a cherished recreational destination for locals and holiday guests.

Lidos and Nature Reserve

Two popular lidos – the Strandperle and Strandbad Sonja – feature sunny sunbathing lawns, beach volleyball, and boat rentals. Along the protected southern shore lies the Reither Moor with sundew and dwarf pines, while the walking trail winds through the famous Seefelder Eichhörnchenwald, where tame forest animals feed right from your hand.
